summary: Intercont (Cayman) Limited filed a Form 6-K disclosing the October 27, 2026 close of a registered direct offering of 15,000,000 Class A ordinary shares at a negotiated US$1.30 per share, for expected gross proceeds of roughly US$19.5 million, sold directly to investors without a placement agent or underwriter. The securities purchase agreements were signed October 21, 2026; shares were issued against investors' unconditional promises to pay within three months of closing, with forfeiture available for non-payment. This is an ordinary shelf takedown, not a special situation; watch settlement/payment risk and dilution overhang.
